fields.description: One item per entity checked. Bad items carry only index + error and are not charged.

index.description: Position of the item in your input (0-based)

verdict.description: Act on this: ALLOW (authorised, nothing against it), REVIEW (a human checks first), BLOCK (warning list or EU sanctions hit)

status.description: licensed | licensed_and_warned | warned | sanctioned | licence_withdrawn | registered_offer | possible_match | not_found | not_covered

notes.description: Context that did not change the verdict

licences.description: Matched register entries (max 5): register, authority, type, status, authorised_since, withdrawn_on, passported_to, services, match {method, confidence}, history {first_seen_by_us, changes}, data_as_of

warnings.description: Matched warning-list entries (max 5) with match method and confidence

sanctions.description: Matched EU sanctions entries (legal entities only)

lookalike_domains.description: Warning-list domains that resemble yours (not counted as a match)

counts.description: Number of licence, warning and sanctions matches before the max-5 cut

claimed_licence.description: Your claimed licence: type, country, covered (false = not_covered), found, found_active

coverage.description: Per source: status (checked / stale / unavailable), scope, data_as_of, refreshed (snapshot / live)

not_covered.description: Registers and lists not included, with the reason

gleif.description: GLEIF record for the LEI you gave

lei.description: LEI status from GLEIF for the LEI you gave, the LEI registered with your KVK number (NL), or the matched register entry's LEI: lei, lei_from (input / kvk / register), lei_source (snapshot / gleif_api / not_in_snapshot / unavailable), data_as_of, legal_name, name_matches, registration_status (ISSUED / LAPSED / RETIRED ...), entity_status, successor_lei, next_renewal, recent_changes (last 90 days of our GLEIF history), renamed_on, lapsed_on. null when no LEI is known.

attribution.description: Source acknowledgements required by the publishers

error.description: Input problem for this item (not charged)
